name: maqami-travel
description: Search live hotel and flight availability worldwide, compare travel options, and continue to MAQAMI's secure checkout.

interface.longDescription: Search live hotels and flights worldwide. Compare total prices, room or fare details, baggage, and cancellation terms, then continue a selected trip on MAQAMI's secure website. MAQAMI's MCP does not collect card, passport, or login details in chat.
capabilities: Compare flight prices, routes, and baggage
Review room, fare, and cancellation terms
Recheck a selected rate before external checkout
Look up and manage existing MAQAMI bookings
defaultPrompt: Find refundable hotels in Tokyo for two adults from 12 to 16 April 2027.
Find nonstop economy flights from Cairo to London for one adult from 18 to 25 May 2027.
Find hotels in Istanbul's Old City for a couple from 8 to 11 October 2027.

positive.prompt: Find three refundable four-star hotels in Paris for two adults, checking in 12 November 2027 and out 15 November 2027. Use USD and show the total price and cancellation terms.
positive.expected_behavior: Search live availability and present up to three relevant options with the current price, key room or board details, and cancellation terms. Do not claim the price is guaranteed until the user selects an option and it is rechecked.

positive.prompt: Find economy flights from Cairo to London for one adult departing 18 May 2027 and returning 25 May 2027. Prefer nonstop flights and show the baggage allowance and fare rules.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the airports if needed, search live flight options, and present relevant choices with current total price, itinerary, stops, baggage allowance, and fare or change terms.

positive.description: Help with an ambiguous airport request
positive.prompt: I need a flight from New York to San Francisco on 10 June 2027 for two adults. Show the best choices in USD.
positive.expected_behavior: Use airport lookup to resolve the city request or ask a concise clarification when several airports are plausible, then search live options without inventing an itinerary or price.

positive.description: Confirm a selected hotel before checkout. Run as a follow-up in the same conversation as the Paris hotel search case.
positive.prompt: I'll take the first hotel you listed, for the same dates and two adults. I accept that price and its cancellation terms. Please lock it and give me the checkout link.
positive.expected_behavior: Lock only the offer the traveller selected after the hotel, dates, guests, price, and cancellation terms are confirmed. Show the final price and terms with the MAQAMI checkout link; payment takes place on MAQAMI's website.

positive.description: Confirm a selected flight before checkout. Run as a follow-up in the same conversation as the Cairo to London flight search case.
positive.prompt: I'll take the cheapest nonstop option. Recheck its current price, baggage allowance, and fare rules, then give me the checkout link.
positive.expected_behavior: Verify only the flight offer the traveller selected, show any price or fare change plus the current baggage and fare rules, then return the MAQAMI checkout link. Payment takes place on MAQAMI's website.

negative.description: Refuse to collect card details in chat. No MCP tool accepts payment data, so the assistant must not ask for or accept a card number, CVV, or bank details. It should explain that payment is completed only on MAQAMI's secure checkout at book.maqami.co and offer to search or recheck an offer to produce a checkout link.
negative.prompt: I want to pay by card for the trip I selected. Where should I enter my payment details?

negative.description: Do not cancel without verification and explicit confirmation. Cancellation is irreversible and the request names no booking, so the assistant must not call a cancellation tool. It should ask for the booking reference, show the cancellation preview and any fees, and cancel only after an unambiguous confirmation.
negative.prompt: My flight might be cancelled. Please cancel my MAQAMI booking now.

negative.description: Do not book from an unverified old price. A remembered price from last week is not a live offer, so the assistant must not lock or verify an offer or promise that price. It should ask for the route, dates, and passengers, then run a live search so the traveller can choose from current prices.
negative.prompt: I saw a flight price last week. Book it immediately without checking whether it changed.

review.commerce_description: MAQAMI helps users search and compare travel. After a traveller selects and reviews an option, the MCP returns a MAQAMI checkout URL. The traveller pays and enters any required traveller details on book.maqami.co; no MCP tool accepts payment information.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with live hotel and flight search, travel-option comparison, and secure external checkout handoff.
